name: Balkan Gate Thessaloniki
notes: Carrier-neutral Tier III data center in Thessaloniki/Kalochori; operator states it has served since 2022 and is the largest carrier-neutral data center in Northern Greece.

name: Synapsecom Thessaloniki Data Center
notes: Synapsecom describes its Thessaloniki facility as a Tier III-standard regional gateway for Northern Greece/Southeast Europe; DataCenterMap lists Synapsecom data centers in Ionia/Thessaloniki and Ano Liosia/Athens.

name: Agios Dimitrios / Kozani Mega Data Center
notes: PPC announced plans for a 300 MW mega data center at Agios Dimitrios Power Plant in Western Macedonia, with a possible phase 2 scaling to 1,000 MW.

name: GRNET Green Datacenter Louros
notes: GRNET states it has installed a green data center on the Louros river in Epirus to improve energy efficiency for national research/education infrastructure.

name: FRK01VOL Volos Data Center
notes: Friktoria describes itself as operating a privately owned Tier-III-design data center, FRK01VOL, located in Volos, Central Greece/Thessaly.

name: Karatzis Group Kastro / Orchomenos Data Center Campus
notes: Reported 240m euro data center campus in Boeotia, Municipality of Orchomenos, near Kastro/Ampelia, planned as seven buildings totaling about 430 MW.

name: Digital Realty Athens Data Center Campus
notes: Digital Realty lists its Athens campus in Koropi, Attica, with three data centers, 10.6k m2 total colocation space, 70+ cloud/network providers, and 135+ customers.

name: ATH3 Athens Data Center
developer: Digital Realty / Lamda Hellix; built by METLEN
notes: METLEN reported delivery of ATH3 in Koropi, Attica; prior project announcement listed 6.8 MW capacity and 8,600 m2 facility size.

name: ATH4 Athens Data Center
notes: Digital Realty/Lamda Hellix announced a fourth Athens data center; Hill International describes ATH4 as a three-story facility with 6.8 MW load and more than 3,000 m2 of white space.

name: ATH5 Athens Data Center
notes: Hill International describes ATH5 in Athens/Koropi as a planned 11,000 m2 site supporting up to 15 MW of installed IT load.

name: Microsoft Greece Cloud Region Datacenters
developer: Microsoft Operations 4733 Hellas Single Member S.A.
notes: Microsoft announced its first Greece datacenter region; Greek strategic-investment listing places three data centers in Attica at Spata and Koropi. RENCO project page describes the first Spata data center as under construction with 19.2 MW installed capacity.

name: DATA4 Athens / Paiania Campus
notes: DATA4 announced a 300m euro Athens-area campus in Paiania with 7.5 ha land reserves and 90 MW available electricity reserves; Hill International describes DC1 as 5,200 m2 and 15 MW.

name: Gemini Athens Hyperscale Data Center
notes: Serverfarm and IPTO signed Heads of Term for Gemini JV; DCD reported the JV plans a 130 MW hyperscale data center in Athens and other Greek IPTO-owned sites.

name: Sparkle Greece Data Centers - Athens Metamorfosis/Koropi
notes: Sparkle says its Greece platform includes Athens data centers in Metamorfosis, Metamorfosis II, and Koropi; DCD reported the 2021 Metamorfosis II opening as a 7.7 MW facility.

name: OTE / Cosmote Rentis Data Center
developer: OTE Group / Cosmote; reconstructed by AKTOR FM
notes: AKTOR describes conversion of an OTE warehouse in Renti, Attica, into a 1,500 m2 data center with 124 racks; Uptime Institute lists Rentis Data Center for OTE Group/Cosmote in Athens.
